propositions: The optionality workflow currently fans out 6 separate jobs (5 per-extra cells plus union) consuming 21 concurrent slots across the navapbc org, limiting parallelization under free GitHub tier constraints (20 total, 5 macOS).

The matrix set {agents, eval, tracing, mcp, grounding} differs from _optional.EXTRAS {agents, eval, grounding, metrics, tracing}; metrics lacks per-extra CI and mcp is server transport with no detection probe.

The refactored workflow must collapse into one job with a loop iterating isolation venvs for each of (_optional.EXTRAS keys ∪ {mcp}) plus one union venv installing [agents,eval,tracing] jointly to surface resolution conflicts.

Loop iteration must invoke interpreters and console scripts by absolute venv path (never bare or activated), accumulate errors via rc variable with continue, and include checked-in test guards preventing silent activation-stacking and missing extra coverage.
The check names in main-protection.snapshot.json must be updated to reflect removal of per-extra and union job names.
clean-core-wheel must remain byte-identical and is the only lane where agents_extra_installed() is False, preventing skipif-degradation tests from being skipped.
